minutes.headline: Planning Board continued the 1325 Mass Ave stormwater hearing to Feb 24 pending DEP and Conservation input
minutes.summary: The board heard a continued stormwater hearing for the 1325 Massachusetts Avenue earth removal site. Abutters objected, and a member pressed for DEP, Conservation Commission and MEPA input before voting. The hearing was continued to February 24. The board also reworked the draft earth removal bylaw and regulations and discussed stormwater bylaw changes. It approved an ANR and prior minutes, and heard committee reports.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board continued the 1325 Massachusetts Avenue stormwater hearing to February 24, pending DEP and Conservation Commission comments and a site visit.
The continuance was moved at 6364 seconds; the minutes record the vote as not audible.
Abutters raised runoff, basin maintenance, noise, dust, wildlife, septic and property values; the property owner said they are complying with the town.
The board agreed earth removal changes: annual permits, a 50-foot setback, a 3:1 slope and public hearings on renewals, with a draft to go to a public forum in March.
The board approved an ANR plan for 425 West Townsend Road and 100 Howard Street, and approved prior minutes; the ANR vote was not audible.

why_it_matters: Neighbors of the 1325 Mass Ave earth removal site have no decision yet on stormwater controls, and the outcome depends on state and Conservation Commission review.
The revised earth removal rules, covering permit terms, setbacks, slopes and renewal hearings, would apply to any site in town and will go to a public forum before adoption.
watch_next: February 24 at 6:35: continued 1325 Mass Ave public hearing.
March: public forum on the draft earth removal bylaw, and a solar bylaw input session advertised for March 23.
